No hot water in the bathroom - a quick apology is what I got. The shower head in room 745 had a leak and dropped all day/night long. Pillows were tall and hard - not conducive of a restful sleep. Breakfast buffet is the only option for almost 12€ even if you just want a cup of coffee. Breakfast people overflows to the lobby area making it very busy and noisy. Staff seemed overwhelmed both during check in and check out times. A very disappointing stay., Hotel sits on a main road so it’s well connected. Room and bathroom were well cleaned.
The rooms toilet was been used before someone else

It is a scandalous to rate this hotel as high the way it appears in the booking site after so many customer complains. As for our 3 night stay - NO hot water for a night and a morning after before a most important meeting in the three days of our stay. The staff didn't do anything (except some artificial smiles which actually were expression of arogance and rudeness) We have been waiting for an answer (as was promised) from the manager on the compensation that we deserve to get ....until now not even an apology! As consistent customer of booking - I am disappointed with you guys . I can't rely on your " trustful" rating ... (You hide the negative responses and you don't highlight enough the negative responses - apparently you don't play any role in pushing such institution as this to improve. I will have to consider to switch to another supplier!, The location

The internet didn't work during my whole stay and although I kept asking for assistance at the front desk (no phone in the rooms to solve these issues) the problem persisted. The worst is that I had to explain myself as if it was me who was doing something wrong when the internet did't work in any of my three devices. So I kept repeating the same explanations to different people in the front desk who did nothing to solve the problem. Quite annoying experience, I must say, especially when the internet is the only "extra" service that this hotel offers., Comfortable bed in a somewhat austere cadre that offers you strictly what you need to get some rest. No extras of any kind (no kettle in the rooms or phone or wardrobe or safe or room service or any other amenity that may make your life easier). Only recommended if you're going to Brussels for work and planning to spend most of the time out of hotel and just go there to sleep.

I was assigned a room facing the inner courtyard while I had specifically requested a room with a panoramic view. The mattress was leaning towards the edge. On the ceiling there was an annoying flashing alarm light even at night. There was no fridge. Booking.com did not give the possibility to book rooms on the top floor with balcony, did not show pictures of the sad inner courtyard and should ensure that those who book well in advance be satisfied with the placement of the room!, Contemporary interior design. Apart from the lady who greeted me at the reception on my arrival (rather awkward), all the other staff members were helpful and kind.

The reason people book hotels for their time away from home is to have a roof over their heads and an opportunity to wash themselves. Motel One somehow almost failed both these basic tourist needs for us. Yes, “almost” is the key word here, but the mood and first impression were ruined. I’ll tell you my story. The day before our booking date I receive an email from booking.com saying my credit card is invalid (my bad, forgot to update it before the trip). It says that unless I updated it within 24 hours, my booking will be cancelled. No big deal, I update it within an hour after the email. In the app my status is changed to “booking confirmed” again. Guess what happened at the front desk? That’s right: they cancelled my damn booking. Absolutely not willing to help and looking at my CONFIRMED booking in the app he doesn’t even apologize. The only room available on the spot is business suite. It seems I don’t have another choice - I pay for business suite: this was about “almost no roof over my head”. What if I was a traveler on budget? What if I simply didn’t have enough money? Not their problem. Cherry on top to the check-in: it was towards midnight and THERE WAS A LINE for check-in. We waited for 25 minutes only to learn that we’ve been cancelled. Another cherry: they blamed Booking.com for not sending an email about cancellation (remember this, it’s important for later). What’s up with lines at midnight? I’ll tell you. The hotel is HUGE. It’s enormous. And only TWO people and the front desk. In our case they called a third one, but it was still 25+ minutes. For this very reason don’t expect special treatment (not even a smile!) because you are not special when there are hundreds of guests. The shower thing. One morning it turns they don’t have hot water. Just no hot water. For me this was strike two. No phones in the room so we go downstairs to ask. As expected, there are a lot of people waiting (in the line, of course) to be explained. Pipes, they say.
Checkin process very slow/queue. Noise/ no sound proofing at all. No toilet paper topup. , Location. Staff Clean
professional organized

I am frustrated with them reserving 90% of the night's cost and requiring to pay the full amount at the till. It takes my bank 10 business days to release the funds. This never happened to me before. I think that the thermostat in my room didn't work, but I could freely open the window., Clean bathroom, bed size and the personnel is friendly enough. The price is adequate.

Let's start from beginning - check in goes very smooth, fast and efficient. You are charged full amount of your stay straight away at the beginning of your stay - that seems to be standard procedure from the Hotels that have very high percentage of customers being dissatisfied about quality and the product being offered. After quick check in we arrived at our room - I will remind everyone here - it's a 3 Star Hotel! Standard room - small, that barely 2 people can fit in it, not talking about luggages. In the middle of the room there is bed, standard bed, queen size in our case, and nothing else!!! On both sides of the bed there were 2 wooden shelves - it looked like the shelves taken from my grandpa old garage. No deposit box or safe! No minibar or fridge! No telephone in the room! No tea or coffee making facilities! No room service - if you wanna have a tea you gotta go down to bar and buy it there! It's 21st Century - even homestays offer kettle in their rooms! Bathroom was so small that you can barely move around - of course no shelves or place to put your cosmetics! We decided not to stay any minute longer in that place! 15 minutes after check in we went down to reception to check out (we suppose to stay in this place for 4 nights). On our way out we have been informed by receptionist to contact Hotel Management about refund for remaining 3 nights - either via phone or email. Unfortunately despite many attempts to contact property both via email and phone nobody ever replies or picks up the phone! We spent the rest of our weekend in Brussels in the proper HOTEL., Near Centre location was the only positive aspect of our very short stay in this so called 3* Hotel.

There was no refrigerator, no telephone, no minibar, no tea or water in the room.The only good thing is location and cleaning.I don’t know the other rooms but the room that they gave me, it’s really not like the 3 stars hotel.I did’t like the

Very small rooms, somehow the definition of standard but completely ok for the price. , Clean bathroom, friendly staff and very delcious breakfast.
